brief:
Meningitis cases in Gaza spiked more than eightfold in October as overcrowded displacement camps, contaminated water supplies, and failing sanitation systems created conditions for rapid disease transmission across the territory, Mondoweiss reported. Children face particular vulnerability to the bacterial infection amid the deteriorating public health crisis.

The surge reflects broader breakdowns in basic services and living conditions across Gaza's sprawling tent encampments housing tens of thousands of displaced Palestinians.
dek: With meningitis cases rising more than eightfold in October, overcrowded displacement camps, contaminated water, and collapsing sanitation systems are creating conditions for the disease to spread across the Gaza Strip.
title: Meningitis cases surge eightfold in Gaza amid collapsing sanitation
